construct.name: matched intervention-to-outcome causal-path qualification
construct.intended_use: Check whether a declared institutional intervention propagates through a typed mechanism and authorized resource transfer to an independently ledger-measured household service outcome under matched exogenous conditions.
construct.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic ledger-backed mechanism-path reference only. It does not establish a real-world causal effect, empirical identification, confounder completeness or policy efficacy.

units.observational_unit: matched intervention arm × typed causal transition × ledger outcome receipt
units.independent_unit: One deterministic four-arm synthetic resource-ledger experiment
units.dependence_statement: Control, treatment, negative-control and mechanism-ablation arms share one declared synthetic exogenous snapshot and are deliberately paired. They are not independent empirical samples.

sources.missingness_semantics: Fixture cells are declared and complete; absent, unsupported and not-applicable values are not encoded as zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: One reservoir, one household and a four-arm intervention, negative-control and mediator-ablation portfolio.

factors.weight_interpretation: Four designed arm roles for one deterministic mechanism test; equal weights are design coverage, not treatment prevalence.
Required path, transition receipt, independent outcome receipt and mechanism-ablation gates are conjunctive, not probabilistically weighted.

perturbation_families.rationale: Enable one declared safeguard while holding exogenous snapshot and all other initial state variables fixed.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Only the declared intervention assignment differs from control; every required transition has a receipt.
expected_invariants: Intervention effect can only qualify through a contiguous typed path.
Final household water coverage is read from the resource ledger.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Deterministic exact reference; no stochastic seed.

perturbation_families.rationale: Preserve the primary intervention but block a named mechanism-stage mediator.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Ablation changes only the declared ablation switch and suppresses the mediator to control value.
expected_invariants: The treatment outcome effect disappears when the claimed mediator is blocked.
A disconnected or unrelated state variable cannot support the required causal path.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Deterministic exact reference; no stochastic seed.

replication_design.independent_unit: One deterministic four-arm synthetic resource-ledger experiment
replication_design.dependence_assessment: Control, treatment, negative-control and mechanism-ablation arms share one declared synthetic exogenous snapshot and are deliberately paired. They are not independent empirical samples.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic run is sufficient to check exact software contracts and negative controls; it does not support confidence intervals or population inference.

metrics.aggregation: paired treatment minus control outcome; reported even when qualification fails
present only when every path, matching, independent-measurement, negative-control and ablation gate passes; otherwise null
negative-control minus control ledger outcome; expected zero
maximum absolute regional stock-flow residual across all arms
required path edges with valid transition receipts divided by required path edges

baselines.description: No safeguard and no inter-region transfer; household receives zero of essential water demand.
Changes only an internal reputation counter; the physical resource ledger outcome must remain unchanged.
Keeps primary safeguard enabled while blocking transfer eligibility; service outcome should return to control.

negative_controls.intervention: Change only the reputation counter while holding physical stocks, transfer eligibility and ledger inputs fixed.
negative_controls.expected_result: Household water coverage remains unchanged from control.

negative_controls.intervention: Keep the safeguard assignment but block the required transfer-eligibility mediator.
negative_controls.expected_result: Treatment effect is suppressed; no qualified mechanism effect is retained.

negative_controls.intervention: Remove or disconnect any required intervention-to-outcome transition edge.
negative_controls.expected_result: The experiment fails path qualification and qualified treatment effect remains null.

negative_controls.intervention: Change the exogenous snapshot ID in one arm.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical observations are used; external generalization is not claimed.

reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic synthetic reference; exact-head GitHub Actions workflow
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: synthetic reference execution only; no complete Humanity Atlas run artifact is claimed.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic ledger-backed mechanism-path reference only. It does not establish a real-world causal effect, empirical identification, confounder completeness or policy efficacy.
known_limitations: The reservoir and household are synthetic, not a Johannesburg water-system model.
The exogenous snapshot ID is a protocol assertion, not cryptographically authenticated by the reference crate.
A complete path proves only that the declared mechanism executed inside this model and the independent ledger outcome changed in this fixture.
Empirical causal identification requires source-backed interventions, defensible assumptions, held-out tests and independent review.
unsupported_strata: Real human populations, institutions, regions, infrastructure systems and operational policy settings.

components.notes: Synthetic oracle or explicit deterministic controller; not a human or LLM.
Stable serial execution in declared input order.
Reject invalid or out-of-contract inputs; no silent repair.
Capture every declared input, step, output and metric; missing records fail closed.
No unseeded random source is used by this deterministic fixture.

scheduler_policy.update_order: stable declared fixture order; deterministic serial execution
scheduler_policy.tie_breaking_rule: stable identifier then stable input index

exposure_policy.eligibility_rule: not applicable to this deterministic reference fixture
exposure_policy.state_visibility: all declared synthetic inputs are visible to the benchmark runner
